sentences.text: Rule eighteen opens with an important exception: except where Rules nine, ten and thirteen otherwise require.
So in a narrow channel, a sailing vessel or a vessel under twenty meters must not impede a large ship that can navigate only in the channel, even though the ship is power-driven.
In a traffic separation scheme, the same applies to vessels following a lane.
And a vessel overtaking always keeps clear, whatever type she is.
On the exam, check whether a question mentions a narrow channel, a traffic lane or overtaking before you apply the ladder.
